newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tight, AA trades boost thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tight, AA trades boost thin trade.

text.p: London's white sugar futures market was confined to trading in the two nearby months on Friday, with May against actuals dealings as the mainstay of the thin turnover.
Ranges stayed tight throughout the session as trade selling counterbalanced broker buying but at 1655 GMT volume totalled 701 lots, nearly all of which was in May.
Limited interest was reported in May/May and August/July arbitrage trades against the New York market, as both premiums remained approximatey in line.
Despite the dearth of activity, traders said the London outlook was turning bearish on account of last week's series of strong closes.
"People have turned their thoughts around to the upside...it keeps trying the downside and keeps rallying," said one.
Sentiment on the whites was most likely to come from the raws where speculators and trade players were holding each other at bay and reducing the nearby values to a tight range, market sources said.
May was up just 50 cents at $308.50 after trading in a $1.60 range and August was up 90 cents.
The Paris market was content to pursue a similar trading pattern to the morning and kept volume low.
May was the only contract traded, as before, up 30 cents at $308.00. Volume reached a total 18 lots.
